description: This PHP source file defines the ProjectCampaignForm class, which extends an abstract form processor and implements form processing for project campaign data in a crowdfunding platform. It manages form creation, validation, and persistence of campaign-related data, including type, impact calculator activation, payment options, and project spread details.

classes.name: ProjectCampaignForm
classes.description: A form processor class for handling project campaign data, including creation, validation, and saving of campaign settings.

methods.name: getPhoneConstraints
methods.description: Returns validation constraints for the phone field, requiring non-blank input if full validation is enabled.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Initializes the form fields for campaign data, including type, impact calculator, payment options, rounds, phone, and spread, with access control for admin users.

methods.name: getRoundsAsChoices
methods.description: Provides choices for the number of campaign rounds.

methods.name: projectTypeChoices
methods.description: Returns choices for project types (campaign or permanent).

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and persists the form data, updating campaign configurations, payment settings, and user contact information, with special handling for admin-level campaign impact settings.
